description: Change how a lambda's editor opens: view 'Simple' shows the app, how it is doing and a box to ask for a change - for an owner who does not write code - and 'Full' every section, the code, files, data, versions and logs included. Only the default: whoever opens the editor can switch for themselves, and that choice stays theirs. Only do this when the user asks for it.

view.description: How the editor opens: 'Full' (the default) shows every section, 'Simple' only the app, how it is doing and a box to ask for a change. Simple suits an owner who is not going to read the code - use it when the user asks for a simple editor, or says they are not a developer.

name: update_lambda
title: Change a lambda's settings
